name: manim-slides
description: Generate, render, and compile interactive Manim-Slides presentations from AI prompts.
long_description:
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets AI agents generate, orchestrate, and compile interactive presentations with manim-slides.

Features:
- Execute Manim code headlessly via `manim-slides render`
- Compile rendered scenes into interactive HTML (Reveal.js), PDF, or PPTX presentations
- Export first-class Reveal.js HTML with themes, transitions, and offline/one-file embedding
- Preview individual slides as images, videos, or GIFs
- Serve the exported deck on a local HTTP server for one-click browser preview
- Render caching and live render-progress reporting
